pages.text: There are a few drinks in Moon's Whatsits, mostly made from ingredients you can grow yourself.$(br2)There are fruit juices, Strawberry Smoothie and Coffee.

pages.title: Drinks
pages.text: The drinks added by the mod are Apple Juice, Cherry Juice, Coffee and Strawberry Smoothie.$(br2)The bottled drinks return a glass bottle when consumed.
Recipes:$(br)Apple Juice: Apple + Glass Bottle$(br)Cherry Juice: Cherry + Glass Bottle$(br)Coffee: Coffee Beans + Milk Bucket$(br)Strawberry Smoothie: Strawberry + Milk Bucket
